## About Us
Today, from our 70,000 plus square foot facility in Belding, Michigan, Belco serves multiple locations nationwide and continues to proudly build not only the most technologically advanced products in the industry, but strong, long-term relationships as well. We’re there from start to finish, standing behind our products from the drawing board to the customers’ shop floor. We are Belco. The Systems Solution People.
[Learn More: Company](https://www.belcoind.com/company-info/)
## Finishing Systems
Our expertise focuses on finishing systems for the coatings industry, supplying washers, ovens, paint spray booths and conveyors to name a few. We design and manufacture custom systems for the paint/powder finishing industry.
[Learn More: Finishing Systems](https://www.belcoind.com/finishing-overview/)[Video Testimonial](https://youtu.be/LbkXM6bSGmU?autoplay=1)

## Extrusion Systems
Our expertise focuses on extrusion systems for the aluminum industry, supplying furnaces, hot log saws, handling systems, die ovens, age ovens and pullers to name a few. Paint and powder finishing operations profit from our design and manufacture.
[Learn More: Extrusion Systems](https://www.belcoind.com/extrusion-overview/)
## Laser
As an OEM, we understand the importance of speed and accuracy. Whether you need finished parts, components, or prototypes, we’ve got you covered. Introducing the Mazak 4020 8.0kW Fiber Laser at Belco Industries!

## _Industrial Age Ovens & Annealing Ovens for Aluminum Extrusion Applications_
Belco designs and manufactures [custom industrial age ovens](https://www.belcoind.com/extrusion-overview/) and [annealing ovens](https://www.belcoind.com/buying-american-better-for-bottom-line/) engineered for the [aluminum extrusion](https://aec.org/features-benefits) industry and other heat treatment applications.
Our [age ovens](https://www.belcoind.com/fifteen-things-to-consider-before-installing-equipment/) are built to deliver consistent temperature uniformity, efficient airflow, and reliable performance for [aluminum aging](https://www.belcoind.com/heres-what-you-need-to-know-about-age-ovens/), annealing, and thermal processing operations.
Each [aging oven](https://www.iqsdirectory.com/articles/industrial-oven/types-of-industrial-ovens.html) created by our [custom machine builder](https://www.belcoind.com/company-info/) is designed to meet your production requirements, available in single end flow, dual end flow, cross flow, and reversing airflow configurations. Our systems are engineered for maximum throughput, minimal heat-up time, and uniform heat distribution from load to load.
Belco [aluminum aging ovens](https://www.belcoind.com/extrusion-overview/) are available in gas (direct or indirect) or electric heated designs and can be integrated with programmable controls, automated load/unload systems, oven carts, racks, and conveyor systems for streamlined production efficiency. Annealing capabilities are available across all oven designs, making them ideal for a wide range of industrial heat treatment processes.
With decades of experience designing [industrial oven systems](https://www.belcoind.com/client-testimonials/) for extrusion manufacturers, Belco delivers durable, energy-efficient solutions built for long-term reliability and performance. Whether you need to [request a quote](https://www.belcoind.com/contact-us/) for a [batch age oven](https://www.belcoind.com/extrusion-overview/), continuous aging system, or fully customized heat treatment oven, our [extrusion and finishing company in Belding, MI](https://www.belcoind.com/), can engineer a solution tailored to your operation.

# Here’s What You Need to Know About Age Ovens
![Age Oven Company in the U.S.](https://www.belcoind.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/age-oven-company.jpg)
### What to Know About Age Ovens
Age ovens heat up plastic and rubber products, artificially aging them to simulate what would happen over years of use. Many industries also use these to test and finish aluminum parts. While they are essential to many industries, it’s normal to still have questions about how these impressive machines work. Continue reading to learn about the features, benefits, and applications of these [industrial ovens](https://www.belcoind.com/).
### Applications
  * Artificial Aging
  * Product Testing and Development
  * Heat Treatment


### Product Testing and Development
Product designers use age ovens to determine how plastic and rubber components age over time. Instead of waiting in real-time, designers can place items inside them to artificially simulate how they’ll break down with natural wear and tear.
In other words, they’re able to fast-forward the process of aging so they can learn what about the product needs to be improved. Each product that’s placed in the oven is comprised of chemicals, which react when exposed to heat.
### Heat Treatment
The automotive, transportation, and aerospace industries use age ovens to increase the yield and tensile strength of aluminum parts. During this heat treatment, aluminum or [aluminum alloy](https://www.belcoind.com/the-benefits-of-designing-with-aluminum-extrusions/) is slowly heated under low temperatures to increase its strength. That way, aluminum parts become more durable and long-lasting. Many industries need [aluminum aging ovens](https://www.belcoind.com/die-age-and-annealing-ovens/) to artificially age and strengthen aluminum parts.
### How Age Ovens Work
All [industrial ovens](https://www.belcoind.com/) need good airflow from the supply duct to the return duct. Otherwise, your oven won’t heat evenly. In other words, you’ll have hot and cold spots in your age oven that will affect the final result. If you’re testing products to see how they’ll age, this will contaminate your findings and affect future product development.
One of the advantages of working with us is that we’ll make sure your oven’s loading configuration is matched with the right airflow. For example, you’ll need full-horizontal airflow to consistently heat an oven with solid shelves. That way, air will be able to pass over and under your shelves.
Our age ovens have high-volume airflow so they heat up fast. This saves you time and ensures your products are always consistently heated, no matter where they’re placed in your industrial age oven. They are also built to last, which means you won’t have to worry about them breaking down and costing you valuable production time.
### Design Considerations
We work with you one-on-one to find the perfect age oven for your needs. Industrial age ovens come in different sizes, models, temperatures, and configurations. We also understand that sometimes our clients need compact industrial ovens that won’t hog valuable floor space.
Most age ovens are batch ovens, which let you artificially age many products at once. These products enter the industrial batch oven via conveyor belt or are loaded onto shelves or trays.

### Stacking Systems
#### Profile Stacker
The Belco Profile Stacker is designed to stack the cut extrusions using an age oven racking shelf. The system will have a set of belts that move the material to the profile stacker centerline. The racks will be transferred under the belts and material will be picked up to load the empty racks.
#### Rack Stacker
The Belco Rack Stacker is designed to stack the fully loaded extrusion racks onto the Age Oven Conveyor to create a full batch to be aged. The rack stacker will pick up one rack and load it onto the corresponding conveyor lane for the operations.
#### Profile De-Stacker
The Belco Automatic Profile/Rack De-Stacker is designed to remove the stacks of racks loaded with profiles similar to the above stacker. The system will have a set of belts that move the material from the stacker centerline to the packing station roller conveyor. The racks will be transferred under the belts and to the rack storage system. 
#### Empty Rack Storage System
The Belco Empty Rack Storage System will receive empty racks from the Rack De-Stacker and place the racks on to a multi-level storage conveyor. An automatic empty lifting and transporting device will pick up the rack and move it to its storage location. The empty rack stacker will stack tall racks on the upper level and the half racks on the lower level of the storage system. The storage system will have a device that will remove the required racks from the lower or upper level based on the customers’ requirements.

# Why Your Company Needs an Automatic Die Cleaning System
![Automatic Die Cleaning System](https://www.belcoind.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/die-cleaning-systems.webp)
Industrial dies go through quite a beating. For proper cleaning, most procedures use a solution with fiberglass particles that gets heated to over 800° Fahrenheit. This process has its risks though, because who wants to be anywhere near an 800° F chemical solution?
At Belco Industries we offer a simpler solution: an [Automatic Die Cleaning System](https://www.belcoind.com/). Not only do they increase safety, but they’ll also help your productions and reduce waste. If you’re looking to learn more about how an automated system will help your [industrial company](https://www.belcoind.com/belcos-automatic-die-cleaning-system-proves-to-be-the-perfect-solution-for-alexandria/), keep reading.
### Increased Safety
When cleaning dies the traditional way, a staff member must insert them into the cleaning solution. As mentioned, this solution is insanely hot (over 800° F) and will sear human skin if it makes contact. It’s commonly used to remove [aluminum](https://www.belcoind.com/the-benefits-of-designing-with-aluminum-extrusions/) build-up that happens from standard die use.
Specially trained staff members must wear industrial gloves when inserting and removing the basket of dies to protect their hands, but accidents can still happen if there’s a splash or spill.
On top of physical danger, the manual process is extremely hazardous because the [chemical solution](https://www.osha.gov/SLTC/confinedspaces/hazards_solutions.html) will release fumes into the air.
With an Automatic Die Cleaning System, you eliminate both the risk of chemical fumes polluting your caustic room and the risk of your team getting a nasty burn injury. As your [Belding systems provider](https://www.belcoind.com/), Belco Industries aims to provide you with the best machines on the market to keep your working environment as safe as possible.
### Efficient and Cost Reductive
With an[ Automatic Die Cleaning System](https://www.belcoind.com/automatic-die-cleaning-system/) from Belco, your company will reduce downtime and save on resources.
Because our [extrusion systems](https://www.belcoind.com/extrusion-overview/) are completely customizable, we’ll be sure to design yours in a way that works best with your company. Each of our Automatic Die Cleaning Systems saves on resources by extending chemical life within the chemical tanks and they improve on processing time by making the cleaning process easier. From a distance, your controller will be able to monitor all your cleaning crates in real-time and run more procedures than traditional methods allow.
### How It Works
The automatic die cleaning process is pretty simple, and once you’re trained on the software you’ll be ready to show others.
The general run-through goes something like this:
  1. Your automatic die cleaning operator loads all the dirty dies into the cleaning crate. The crate will then get moved from a loading table to a transfer table.
  2. Via touch screen control, the operator has an automatic hoist pick up the crate from the transfer table and begins the cleaning operation.
  3. The dies go through a thorough cleaning operation to remove any gunk like aluminum build up.
  4. After the operation completes, the dies are brought to a processing zone where they’re safely unloaded and await an operator inspection.


Belco’s automatic system features a 304 SS double-welded caustic mix tank that can hold 1,400 gallons of solution. Within one hour, the tanks are up to working heat and ready for the cleaning process. This [automated process](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Automation) allows for a simple cleaning system that’s flexible with your company’s needs.
### Easy Installation
With Belco Industries as your system solutions people, we’ll make sure your Automatic Die Cleaning System is properly installed and ready to go.
Once set up, we’ll also make sure you and your team know how to operate the software so that your company is ready for all your future productions.

# 5 Ways Preventive Maintenance Saves Manufacturers Money
![Belco Service Department technician performing preventive maintenance on industrial equipment](https://www.belcoind.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/industrial-preventive-maintenance-support.jpg)
[Industrial equipment](https://www.ien.com/) rarely fails at a convenient time. When a [finishing system](https://www.belcoind.com/finishing-overview/), [industrial oven](https://www.belcoind.com/oven-maintenance-101/), burner control, or [extrusion system](https://www.belcoind.com/extrusion-overview/) develops a problem, the resulting downtime can affect production schedules, labor costs, product quality, and customer commitments. [Industrial preventive maintenance](https://www.belcoind.com/contact-us/) helps manufacturers identify developing issues earlier and make more informed service decisions before a small concern becomes a larger disruption.
[Belco’s Service Department](https://www.belcoind.com/contact-us/) supports customers throughout the equipment lifecycle with troubleshooting, [equipment evaluations](https://www.belcoind.com/fifteen-things-to-consider-before-installing-equipment/), [oven surveying](https://www.belcoind.com/what-type-of-age-oven-should-you-buy/), instrument certification, burner control setup and troubleshooting, component repair or replacement, and startup and commissioning support.
Here are 5 ways a proactive maintenance approach can protect both equipment performance and the bottom line.
## 1. Reduces Unplanned Equipment Downtime
Unexpected shutdowns can stop production while maintenance teams diagnose the problem, locate a replacement component, and arrange service. Routine inspections and [industrial equipment evaluations](https://www.belcoind.com/contact-us/) create opportunities to identify wear, control issues, damaged components, or performance changes before they cause a complete interruption. Addressing those findings during planned downtime can be far less disruptive than responding after equipment stops.
## 2. Helps Control Repair and Replacement Costs
A developing equipment issue can place additional strain on connected components. If it continues unnoticed, the repair may become more extensive and expensive. Preventive extrusion or [finishing equipment maintenance](https://www.belcoind.com/finishing-overview/) gives manufacturers better visibility into equipment condition, making it easier to repair or replace components when the need is manageable and to budget for future work instead of absorbing an unexpected expense.
## 3. Supports Consistent Process Performance
Equipment can continue running while gradually moving away from expected operating conditions. For [industrial ovens](https://www.iqsdirectory.com/articles/industrial-oven/types-of-industrial-ovens.html) and thermal processes, inaccurate instruments, uneven temperature performance, or burner control issues may affect consistency and create avoidable rework. Instrument certification, burner control setup, troubleshooting, and oven surveying can help maintenance and production teams verify performance and respond to issues that may be affecting the process.
## 4. Extends the Useful Life of Industrial Equipment
Well-maintained equipment is better positioned for long-term service. Regular attention to operating conditions, controls, and components helps prevent minor issues from accelerating wear elsewhere in the system. When repairs or component replacement are handled at the appropriate time, manufacturers can protect their equipment investment and make replacement decisions based on operational needs rather than an emergency.
## 5. Makes Maintenance Planning More Predictable
A proactive service approach gives teams more information to plan labor, parts, production schedules, and outside support. Finishing and [extrusion equipment service](https://www.belcoind.com/contact-us/), evaluations, and documented service findings can help prioritize what needs immediate attention, what should be monitored, and what can be scheduled for a future shutdown. That clarity supports more predictable maintenance spending and fewer last-minute decisions.
## How Belco’s Service Department Supports Your Equipment
Belco’s Service Department works with new and existing equipment to help manufacturers understand problems, verify performance, and determine the appropriate next step.
**Available support includes:**
  * Startup and commissioning of new equipment
  * Troubleshooting for new and used equipment
  * Repair or replacement of components as needed
  * Instrument certification for temperature controls
  * Burner control setup and troubleshooting
  * [Industrial oven surveying](https://www.belcoind.com/contact-us/)
  * Equipment evaluations


## When Should You Contact an Industrial Equipment Service Team?
You do not need to wait for a complete breakdown. Consider contacting Belco’s Service Department when equipment performance changes, temperature controls require certification, an oven needs to be surveyed, burner controls are not operating as expected, components need repair or replacement, or your team wants a clearer understanding of the equipment’s condition.
## Frequently Asked Questions
### What is industrial preventive maintenance?
Industrial preventive maintenance is planned inspection, testing, servicing, and component care intended to identify issues before they cause an unexpected equipment failure or production interruption.
### How can preventive maintenance reduce manufacturing costs?
It can reduce unplanned downtime, support earlier repairs, limit secondary component damage, improve maintenance planning, and help equipment operate more consistently.
### What is an industrial oven survey?
An [industrial oven survey](https://www.belcoind.com/contact-us/) evaluates temperature performance throughout an industrial oven so a manufacturer can better understand uniformity and whether the process is operating as expected.
### Does Belco service existing equipment?
Belco’s Service Department troubleshoots both new and used equipment and can evaluate equipment, certify temperature-control instruments, support burner controls, and repair or replace components as needed.
## Talk With Belco’s Service Department
Do not wait for an equipment issue to become a production emergency. The Belco Service Department can help with troubleshooting, an equipment evaluation, oven surveying, temperature-control instrument certification, burner control support, or component repair and replacement. Since 1959, customers from all over the world have turned to Belco Industries for the extrusion equipment they need. One of the last true “Made in America” corporations, Belco has built a reputation for delivering high-quality products and exceptional service, from in-house design and manufacturing, to onsite installation and customer support.
